scope: Read-only preimplementation design review; no compiler/native execution qualification
head: 7a74b77a284940e08756384f3a7c1f30e40effd7

case.name: protection-transform-correspondence
case.assertion: Owner-held security_barrier views project each catalog transform (mask function classes, generalize buckets/date truncation, hash) for the authored Resource fields; per-actor disclosed values match the independent Python oracle byte-exact, with storageEffect and output-domain metadata on the disclosure transport; the base table grants no ordinary SELECT.

conclusion: Fixed versioned native provider is a viable prerequisite. P02 remains required/not-run until every original assertion conjunct has actual integrated evidence. Expression-only component cannot qualify P02.
required_conjuncts: Source-derived exact catalog transform/domain/parameter binding, not an independently fabricated recipe standing in for source
All five named mask classes, prefix, exact integer/decimal buckets, explicit Gregorian truncation and actual SHA256 for authored Resource fields
Actual owner-held security_barrier view, qualified owner/RLS/session identity and dependency/definition inventory
Each ordinary actor executes native query; independent Python expected eligibility and exact output bytes
Source-pinned disclosure transport with exact outputDomain and storageEffect, no claim codec verifies transformation
Effective ordinary base/column SELECT absence; excluded privileged routes explicit
Original 60000ms, pinned PostgreSQL18.6 image/client, source stability and owned cleanup before accepted receipt

regex: Versioned exact language: nonempty literals or exactly [0-9]+; explicit all-occurrence versus first replacement
Literal replacement handling must prevent PostgreSQL replacement backreferences; reject all unsupported pattern/flag constructs
C collation/UTF8 and scalar/null/size rules; no normalization or fallback to constant
Unknown provider/recipe fails before SQL installation; no native/JS authored code execution
numeric: Use exact numeric coefficient div/mod with negative-remainder floor correction
No JS Number/binary float, quotient rounding, integer overflow or precision-cast rounding
Explicit exact scale/precision/output refinements and finite bounds; reject NaN/Infinity
strings: Unicode scalar counts, no grapheme/NFC inference; short prefix/suffix never overlap
Constant/null-out still require valid present input; nullable input does not suppress constant or null-out
Other recipes propagate null only if both selected domains permit it
PostgreSQL text cannot represent NUL/invalid UTF8; explicit carrier refusal required rather than silent loss
date: Explicit CONTRACT066 profile; strict ASCII date/calendar validity/year0001..9999
Year/quarter/month/day, no timezone or host Date inference; no broad native date-cast admission
Native output matches exact profile text and transport valueProfile
hash: Explicit SHA256 over exact UTF8 bytes; exact lower-hex or binary output domain chosen, never inferred
Unsalted effective equality and mandatory dictionary warning retained
Native provider execution does not activate pure .2 hash API or qualify keyed/vault custody
source_and_transport: Exact qualified Field/policy/catalog/core pins, all typed parameters and output refinements
No inference of permission from transform classification; eligibility remains separately declared fixed membership profile
Read-time transform BindingReceipt storageEffect=disclosed-only maps to transport column storageEffect=canonical; retain both exact vocabularies
Stored token/decryption/crypto custody not qualified; no native renderer accepting substituted same-family Fields
native_profile: Owner/view definition/options/dependency and effective role/base/column grants retained
View owner RLS context requires explicitly qualified non-bypass owner/FORCE RLS and original SESSION_USER membership
Pin builtin schemas/types/operators; quote or encode all source values and identifiers
Security barrier alone is not a whole-query leakage/effect/authority theorem; P03 and other unbound cases remain separate

independent_vectors: Supplementary scalars, combining sequences, empty strings, overlap and exact counts
Quotes/backslashes/metacharacters in literal patterns and replacements; ASCII versus non-ASCII digits
Integer and decimal positive/negative boundary, >2^53, large width-1, nonzero origin, output overflow
Leap years1900/2000, all quarter boundaries, invalid/expanded dates, null input/output
SHA256 empty/ASCII/Unicode bytes and exact output casing/width
Actual wrong-expression and base-grant weakening, no case promotion from inventory alone
limits: No native commands executed for this design review
No production compiler/source changes or native authority/admission issued
Design checklist is not a complete transitive privilege/DDL/role lifetime or CPU/heap theorem
